Multi-Group Cross-Network Architecture Graph

Source: R/type_cross_network_graph.R
type_cross_network_graph.Rd

Creates publication-ready multi-group network comparison graphs to visualize co-occurrence networks, module conservation, and cross-network shared links across multiple experimental groups or conditions (e.g. KO vs WT vs OE, Healthy vs Lesional vs Non-Lesional, or Multi-Cohort comparisons). Supports two representations:

  • level = "node": Full network topology with modular clusters, shaded transparent module hulls, intra-group edges, and inter-group cross-links connecting shared or conserved features.

  • level = "module": Module-level circular ring architecture where each group is represented as a ring of module nodes sized by module member count, with inter-group links showing module-level preservation.

Usage

type_cross_network_graph(
  level = c("node", "module"),
  groups = NULL,
  layout = c("triangle", "horizontal", "vertical", "grid"),
  module_colors = NULL,
  cross_colors = NULL,
  show_hulls = TRUE,
  hull_alpha = 0.18,
  show_meta = TRUE,
  node_size_range = c(1.2, 4.2),
  edge_color = "grey85",
  edge_alpha = 0.45,
  edge_width = 0.2,
  cross_width = 0.6,
  cross_alpha = 0.75,
  show_module_labels = NULL,
  module_labels = NULL,
  module_label_size = 2.6,
  module_label_color = "grey15",
  module_label_fill = "white",
  module_label_bg = TRUE,
  meta_label_size = 3.2,
  meta_label_color = "grey15",
  module_size_range = c(3.5, 8.5),
  circle_radius = 1.05,
  preset = c("default", "nature", "cell", "science", "lancet"),
  scifig = FALSE
)

Arguments

level

Character string specifying visualization level: "node" (default) for full node-edge topology, or "module" for circular module ring preservation.

groups

Character vector specifying group names in desired layout order.

layout

Character string specifying group layout: "triangle" (default for 3 groups), "horizontal", "vertical", or "grid".

module_colors

Optional named vector of colors for modules.

cross_colors

Optional named vector of colors for inter-group cross links (e.g. c("KO - WT" = "#E7298A")).

show_hulls

Logical. If TRUE, draws semi-transparent shaded hulls around modules (node level). Default TRUE.

hull_alpha

Numeric transparency for module hulls (default 0.18).

show_meta

Logical. If TRUE, prints group metadata (Node and Edge counts). Default TRUE.

node_size_range

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying point size range (default c(1.2, 4.2)).

edge_color

Color for intra-group edges (default "grey85").

edge_alpha

Transparency for intra-group edges (default 0.45).

edge_width

Width for intra-group edges (default 0.2).

cross_width

Width for cross-group links (default 0.6).

cross_alpha

Transparency for cross-group links (default 0.75).

show_module_labels

Logical. If TRUE, displays labels for module components in the circles. Defaults to TRUE when level = "module" and FALSE when level = "node".

module_labels

Optional named vector of custom labels for modules.

module_label_size

Numeric font size for module labels (default 2.6).

module_label_color

Color of module labels (default "grey15").

module_label_fill

Background fill color for module labels (default "white").

module_label_bg

Logical. If TRUE (default), renders labels in a pill badge.

meta_label_size

Font size for group metadata text (default 3.2).

meta_label_color

Text color for group metadata text (default "grey15").

module_size_range

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying point size range for module circles (default c(3.5, 8.5)).

circle_radius

Radius for module circle ring layout when level = "module" (default 1.05).

preset

Character string specifying publisher style preset: "default", "nature", "cell", "science", or "lancet".

scifig

Logical. If TRUE, enforces AI4SciFig publication gates (font floor >= 5 pt, line floor >= 0.25 pt, and CVD compliant palettes).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.
